summary: The main article describes a distal C-H functionalization of alkoxyarenes using organic photoredox catalysis and radical-radical coupling. It includes a detailed optimization table, a substrate scope figure covering various functional groups, and mechanistic studies supported by radical trapping and DFT calculations.
